conflicts.description: The Windborne Court seeks to consolidate control of all skybridge tolls, choking Caeluna's authority and the Driftward's survival alike — an ambition that could harden into open war just as the bridges need unified stewardship most.
conflicts.name: The Toll War

conflicts.description: The Bridgekeepers concealed the fraying for generations to prevent panic; now that the Inkbound Conclave has proof, publishing it would expose the Keepers' betrayal and shatter the last thread of shared trust between the enclaves.
conflicts.name: The Silence of the Keepers

conflicts.description: Thalen's Reach, closest to the void and first to fray, demands its failing skybridge be renewed before the central isles' grander spans — a demand the wealthy enclaves dismiss, even as the Reach considers severing ties entirely.
conflicts.name: The Abandoned Reach

description: Long ago, a single verdant continent was torn asunder in an event the elders call the Shattering, and its fragments did not fall — they rose. Now the Aeloria Drift is a scattered archipelago of floating islands, adrift upon rivers of luminous aether, bound one to another by ancient skybridges woven from stone and living light. For a thousand years these spans have carried traders, envoys, and dreamers between the enclaves, each bridge anchored by paired keystone shrines whose magic hums beneath the feet of every traveler. But the hum is faltering. In the cartographers' halls of Caeluna, young mapmakers have begun to notice what no one wishes to say aloud: the islands are drifting farther apart, the skybridge light is dimming, and the great spans — built by a craft long forgotten — are beginning to fray. Each enclave has grown proud and insular over the centuries, hoarding its charts, its tolls, and its secrets, even as the connective tissue of their world weakens. The realm's fate now rests on whether rival islands can be persuaded to trust one another before the bridges fail and the Drift scatters its people into the boundless sky. The world is rendered in tones of wonder — sunrise markets held on swaying spans, sky-sails catching violet winds, maps inked in light — yet threaded with the quiet dread of a coming unraveling.

factions.description: The cartographers' guild of Caeluna, sworn to chart every isle, span, and current of the Drift. They alone possess the records that prove the islands are pulling apart, and they are torn between publishing the truth and protecting their guild's fragile authority.
factions.name: The Inkbound Conclave

factions.description: Velyre's alliance of merchant houses and sky-sail captains, who see the failing bridges not as a crisis but as an opportunity — whoever controls the last safe crossings controls the Drift.
factions.name: The Windborne Court

factions.description: A dwindling order of wardens who tend the keystone shrines at either end of every skybridge. They have known of the fraying longer than anyone and kept it secret, fearing that panic would tear the enclaves apart faster than the drift itself.
factions.name: The Bridgekeepers

factions.description: The fishers, shepherds, and exiles of Thalen's Reach, who have watched their own skybridge dim year by year while the central enclaves sent only toll collectors. Their grievances are old, justified, and ready to ignite.
factions.name: The Driftward

history.description: A thousand years past, the continent of Aeloria was torn apart in a single night of thunder, and its fragments rose into the sky upon newborn aether currents rather than falling into the sea.
history.name: The Shattering

history.description: In the chaos after the Shattering, the first Bridgekeepers discovered how to bind the drifting isles with skybridges of stone and living light, reuniting sundered families and founding the enclaves.
history.name: The Raising of the First Spans

history.description: The enclaves swore the Toll of Crossing and divided stewardship of the skybridges among themselves — a treaty that sowed the seeds of today's rivalries.
history.name: The Concord of Caeluna

history.description: A century ago, a skybridge at the archipelago's edge frayed and collapsed despite every prayer and repair, taking an isle and its people into the open sky. Its remains are now the Sundered Span, and the enclaves agreed never to speak of the warning it represented.
history.name: The Fall of the Western Span

history.description: In recent seasons, cartographers of the Inkbound Conclave have charted the isles drifting measurably farther apart, while Bridgekeepers report the keystone lights dimming — first at Thalen's Reach, then everywhere.
history.name: The First Fraying

locations.description: The largest and oldest isle of the Drift, crowned by terraced citadels of pale stone and the great Hall of Charts, where generations of cartographers have inked the slow wanderings of the islands. Caeluna's bridges see the most traffic, and its rulers claim first authority over the spans — a claim its rivals bitterly contest.
locations.name: Caeluna

locations.description: A windswept isle of cliff-top harbors and billowing sky-sails, where merchant houses grown rich on tolls and trade have built a court of silver towers. Velyre controls the eastern routes and dreams of seizing the skybridge tollways for itself.
locations.name: Velyre

locations.description: The smallest inhabited isle, drifting at the rim of the archipelago where the aether currents grow thin and cold. Its hardy fishers and sky-shepherds feel abandoned by the central enclaves, and their single aging skybridge frays faster than any other.
locations.name: Thalen's Reach

locations.description: The broken ruin of the first skybridge to fail, a century past — two arms of crystallized light reaching toward each other over an abyss of open sky. Pilgrims and scholars come to study its silent keystone shrines; scavengers come for its fallen fragments.
locations.name: The Sundered Span

name: The Aeloria Drift

rules.description: Islands float upon invisible aether currents that wax and wane with the seasons. An isle cut loose from its anchors drifts with the current and cannot be steered by sails or rudders.
rules.name: Aether Buoyancy

rules.description: Every skybridge is sustained by two keystone shrines, one rooted on each isle it joins. If either shrine's light fails, the span frays from the middle outward — first dimming, then shedding fragments, then collapse.
rules.name: Paired Keystones

rules.description: The aether that bears the isles also smothers violent ignition: explosive mixtures and combustion-driven weapons fizzle and die in open sky. Warfare in the Drift is fought with blade, bow, wind, and cunning.
rules.name: Cold Combustion

rules.description: By ancient concord, no traveler may cross a skybridge without paying toll or offering a reciprocal gift to the enclave on the far side. The custom keeps the peace — and keeps the enclaves at one another's throats over what is owed.
rules.name: The Toll of Crossing

rules.description: The art of raising new skybridges died with the first Bridgekeepers. Keystones can be tended, prayed over, and repaired in small ways, but no living soul knows how to kindle a new span.
rules.name: The Lost Craft
